_meta.note: Three vendors = the exact Air Force ANPI slate (Antares, Radiant, Westinghouse). Selecting the third vendor was not a judgment call: DoD already paired these three against three named bases in April 2026. Updated 2026-08-29 with the Army's Janus awards (2026-08-26). Janus added two buyers this slate does not cover — BWXT at Fort Campbell and General Atomics at Fort Hood — so these three are no longer the whole field; they are the three that appear in both the Air Force and Army programs.

vendors.name: Antares Nuclear
vendors.notes: Antares plants require no connection to the commercial power grid or specialized infrastructure to deploy. Selection driven by JBSA's utility infrastructure, land availability and critical mission requirements. Under the DOE Reactor Pilot Program, Antares' Mark-0 test reactor reached zero-power fuelled criticality at Idaho National Laboratory on 2026-06-04 — one of the first three pilot reactors to meet the executive order's July 4 deadline. Under the Army's Janus program, announced 2026-08-26, Antares will own, build and operate a three-unit R1 deployment at Fort Bragg. It did not disclose that contract's value, but states its combined book across Janus, the Air Force ANPI award at Joint Base San Antonio and Space Force work is on the order of $1 billion. Janus reactors are licensed by the Army, not the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.

vendors.name: Westinghouse
vendors.test_reactor: Scaled 3 MWt heat-pipe nuclear test reactor at INL DOME, testing from 2026
vendors.commercial: First-customer SRC pilot (CA$80M, target 2029) cancelled by Westinghouse in fall 2025 — eVinci refocused on space, defense and government applications. Penn State FRONTIER: NRC notice of intent filed 2025-02-17 for a construction permit for a 15 MWt eVinci-based research reactor at University Park, PA.
vendors.notes: The only one of the three with a published site-footprint figure — designed to produce 5 MWe on sites as small as two acres. Delivers 24/7 for eight-plus years without refueling. Westinghouse Government Services was selected for the Army's Janus program at Fort Drum, NY on 2026-08-26. Neither the contract value nor the unit count was disclosed.
